name: Social media
blurb: Plan, write and publish posts, threads, carousels and short video scripts across platforms, then listen, engage and grow.
searches: social media agent skill Claude new release
X algorithm ranking signals update xai-org/x-algorithm
Instagram TikTok algorithm change 2026 reach saves shares
short-form video hook retention study new data
social media scheduling API MCP server new

tests.prompt: I run a small bakery in Leeds with Instagram and Facebook. I can spend 3 hours a week. Build me a 4-week content calendar and write the first week's posts.
tests.good: Sustainable cadence (about 2-4 posts/week); pillar mix with promotion capped near 10-20%; calendar rows with date, channel, format, hook, CTA and status; Facebook and Instagram versions differ; Instagram uses at most 5 hashtags; real, specific hooks with no invented prices or reviews; asks for or flags missing photos.

tests.prompt: Turn this 1,500-word blog post about how we cut our SaaS onboarding time from 14 days to 3 into an X thread, a LinkedIn post and a 30-second Reel script.
tests.good: Thread opens with a specific one- or two-line hook, 5-9 posts each under 280 characters, no link in post 1; LinkedIn hook lands before ~210 characters with link in comments; Reel script has hook in 0-3 s, timed beats, on-screen text and a CTA; no identical copy across platforms; no AI tells or invented numbers.

tests.prompt: Set up posting to X and TikTok from Claude so I can schedule next week's content automatically.
tests.good: Recommends official routes (xurl or X API v2, Composio TikTok or a scheduler the user already has); drafts first and publishes only after explicit approval; future-time and rate-limit checks; secrets kept out of commands and files; warns that browser automation of x.com and cookie scraping risk account bans; TikTok unaudited apps may be limited to private posts.

tests.prompt: Plan a two-week launch on X and Instagram for our budgeting app: a launch thread, three Reel scripts and a 7-slide carousel with designed slides, then schedule everything through official APIs.
tests.good: States a short plan first: calendar, thread and X publishing here (strategy-calendar.md, x-threads.md, publishing-apis.md), Reels and Instagram publishing through instagram-automation (reels-scripting.md, graph-api-publishing.md: scored hooks, content_publishing_limit checked, Graph API only), slide design through poster-design (banners-social.md: 1080x1350, one grid, readable type). No identical copy across platforms; no invented user numbers; nothing published without an explicit yes, and provider IDs read back; checks the Done means of all three crafts.

tests.prompt: I have Buffer (free plan) with my LinkedIn, X and Instagram connected. Here are this week's three launch posts (copy and one image each). Use Claude to put them in my Buffer queue so I can look them over before anything goes out. Spread them Tue, Wed and Thu at 9am my time (Europe/London).
tests.good: Connects through Buffer's official MCP (https://mcp.buffer.com/mcp, OAuth) or its GraphQL API with the key in an environment variable, never pasted into chat, commands or files; lists the connected channels and confirms which channel each post goes to before creating anything; creates drafts or scheduled queue items rather than posting now, and shows the exact text, image, channel and time for approval first; checks the times are in the future and in Europe/London (BST vs GMT), and respects the free plan's 3-channel and scheduled-post limits; adapts copy per network (no identical text on all three, X under 280 chars, Instagram needs the image and a post type, link placement for LinkedIn) rather than one blast; reads back each post's Buffer ID, channel, scheduled time and status and says plainly which items are queued versus not created; nothing is published live and no auto-engagement is done.

tools.name: Buffer
tools.why: Ranked #1 overall in Buffer's own 2026 round-up (200,000+ creators monthly, free plan for 3 channels) and opened a public GraphQL API plus an official MCP server in 2026.

tools.name: Hootsuite
tools.why: Over 18 million users and 35+ networks per 2026 round-ups; shipped four official MCP servers (Perch, Nest, Lumen, Parliament) in June 2026.

tools.name: Sprout Social
tools.why: Tops 2026 rankings and is trusted by 30,000+ brands (Sprout/Guideflow round-ups); public API covers analytics, messages, listening and draft publishing, plan-gated.

tools.name: Canva
tools.why: Described as the most widely used social design tool in 2026 and has an official Claude connector (create, resize, autofill, export designs) at mcp.canva.com.

tools.name: Meta Business Suite and Graph API (Instagram, Facebook)
tools.why: Facebook (86%) and Instagram (82%) lead marketer usage per Statista Jan 2026, and Meta Business Suite is the free native scheduler/inbox/insights hub for both; the publishing API allows 100 posts per 24 h.

tools.name: X API and xurl
tools.why: X is used by 23% of marketers (Statista Jan 2026); the API is now pay-per-usage and xurl is X's own official CLI.

tools.name: LinkedIn Posts API
tools.why: LinkedIn is used by 72% of marketers (Statista Jan 2026); the versioned Posts API (text, image, video, document, poll, multi-image) needs w_member_social or w_organization_social and sunsets old versions on a schedule.

tools.name: CapCut
tools.why: About 68% of short-form creators use CapCut weekly (2025 Creator Economy Council survey as cited) and it holds roughly 65% of mobile short-form editing; no public API, so hand-off or manual steps only.

tools.name: YouTube Data API and YouTube Studio
tools.why: YouTube is used by 58% of marketers (Statista Jan 2026); videos.insert from unverified API projects is locked private until audited.

tools.name: TikTok Content Posting API
tools.why: TikTok is used by 32% of marketers (Statista Jan 2026); the Content Posting API exposes direct post and upload, with unaudited clients restricted to private posts.

tools.name: Metricool
tools.why: Listed in Claude's connector directory with an official MCP (analytics, scheduling, best times, review workflows) that works on a free account.

tools.name: Postiz
tools.why: Open-source self-hostable scheduler with 36,000+ stars, a public API, an MCP and an official agent CLI covering 28+ channels.

tools.name: Ayrshare
tools.why: Unified publishing API for 14 networks with an official hosted MCP and a Claude Code plugin; recommended in Claude's social media MCP lists.

tools.name: Bluesky AT Protocol
tools.why: Open protocol where posts are JSON records created with an authenticated API call; Bluesky is a standard crosspost target.

tools.name: Adobe Express (Adobe for creativity connector)
tools.why: Adobe's official Claude connector (April 2026) lets Claude make social post designs and open them as editable Express documents with brand kit and resizing.

tools.name: Threads API
tools.why: Threads passed 500M monthly users in June 2026 and is used by 13% of marketers (Statista Jan 2026), more reach than Bluesky which is listed; the official API publishes text, image, video and 20-item carousels via a container then threads_publish, 250 posts per 24 h, 500-char text, max 5 links.

tools.name: Brandwatch
tools.why: Called the dominant enterprise social listening platform by market share in 2026 listening round-ups (Pulsar, Meltwater, Brand24 lists all rank it top tier); Consumer Research API exposes projects, queries, mentions, topics and author data.

tools.name: Meltwater
tools.why: Ranked best overall or top-3 in 2026 social listening and media-monitoring round-ups alongside Brandwatch and Talkwalker, and is an approved Claude connector with an official MCP (api.meltwater.com/mcp, API-key header) for news and social mentions, trends and sentiment.

tools.name: Linktree
tools.why: 50M+ users and about 80% of link-in-bio users per a 2025 market study; the default way creators route Instagram and TikTok traffic. Developer APIs are partner-gated (register interest), so in practice it is a manual step.

tools.name: Later
tools.why: Long-standing visual scheduler (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads, YouTube, Snapchat) in most 2026 scheduler round-ups, now centred on influencer marketing (Later Influence, ex-Mavrck) plus its own link in bio; no public API or MCP found, so CSV or manual hand-off.

tools.name: Sprinklr Social
tools.why: Named a Leader in Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Social Media Management and Listening and the Forrester Wave Q4 2024 social suites; the enterprise standard for multi-brand publishing, engagement and listening, with a developer portal but no self-serve pricing.

tools.name: CreatorIQ
tools.why: Enterprise influencer platform used by 1,300+ brands and agencies (Unilever, Nestle, Sephora, Google) and named best for enterprise creator programs in 2026 platform comparisons; discovery, contracting, payments and reporting, API via ExchangeIQ.

tools.name: Modash
tools.why: Largest self-serve creator database (200M+ Instagram, TikTok and YouTube profiles) and a common pick for influencer discovery in 2026 comparisons; public Discovery and Raw APIs with a bearer token, failed calls not billed.
